blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
. Activation steering has gained popularity as a lightweight inference-time debiasing technique for large language models.
However, prior work reports that steering vectors generalise poorly, with unintended effects on model performance and limited transfer to new datasets.
Our work analyses what the debiasing direction used for activation steering actually encodes, in order to shed light on its inconsistent performance.
We study the linear debiasing direction obtained by contrasting the activations of anti-biased and biased prompts, and evaluate it as a steering intervention across bias and general knowledge benchmarks.
We find that this direction is dominated by model confidence, pointing from regions of high to low-probability tokens in activation space rather than encoding a meaningful representation of model bias.
Steering along it does reduce measured bias, but this is a consequence of reducing model confidence: on QA benchmarks we find that this steering drives the model to abstain from answering, with a side effect of improving fairness metrics. Our experiments show that model confidence is the dominant separating factor between biased and anti-biased prompts in hidden space, indicating that isolating a linear representation of bias which is disentangled from model confidence is difficult and steering-based debiasing results should be interpreted with care. In short, steering appears to reduce bias, not by correcting the model’s underlying preferences, but by making it less confident, even on tasks unrelated to bias.

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 导言

blocks.en:
Large language models (LLMs) exhibit the social biases inherited from their training data ( UNESCO and IRCAI, 2024 ; Li et al., 2023b ; Gallegos et al., 2024 ; Bai et al., 2025 ) , and their widespread deployment risks propagating unfair stereotypes into real-world applications ( Omar et al., 2025 ) . Among the proposed mitigation strategies, activation steering is a popular inference-time solution for suppressing the biased behaviour of LLMs ( Li et al., 2023a ; Zou et al., 2023 ; Rimsky et al., 2024 ; Turner et al., 2023 ) .
Steering takes advantage of the linear representation hypothesis ( Park et al., 2024 ) , under which meaningful semantic concepts are encoded linearly in the LLM activation space.
A steering vector representing the target behaviour is added to the model’s residual stream to shift the model’s outputs towards the intended behaviour. For debiasing, a debiasing vector is obtained by contrasting the activations of anti-biased and biased prompts ( Rimsky et al., 2024 ) . Previous studies ( Li et al., 2025 ; Siddique et al., 2026 ; Durmus et al., 2024 ; Lu and Rimsky, 2024 ) have shown that steering along the direction of this debiasing vector reduces bias across benchmarks such as the Bias Benchmark for QA (BBQ) ( Parrish et al., 2022 ) , CrowS-Pairs ( Nangia et al., 2020 ) and StereoSet ( Nadeem et al., 2021 ) .

blocks.en: Our first contribution is to show that the debiasing direction in activation space is dominated by a confidence component rather than a direction that purely represents model bias. We show that although biased and anti-biased prompts are found to be linearly separable in intermediate model layers, the separating factor is the likelihood difference between the tokens, with the resulting vector pointing from high- to low-likelihood regions of activation space. Fig. 1 (left) shows that a logistic regression classifier trained on the hidden space embeddings of biased and anti-biased prompts from the BBQ dataset performs poorly as a classifier of biased and anti-biased prompts in disambiguated contexts, while Fig. 1 (middle) shows that the same classifier cleanly separates the same prompts by highest versus lowest likelihood.
blocks.zh: 我们的第一个贡献是表明,激活空间的去偏移方向是由信心部分所支配,而不是纯粹代表模型偏差的方向. 我们显示,虽然在中间模型层中发现有偏颇和反偏颇的提示是线性相分离的,但分离的因子是信使之间的可能差,由此产生的矢量指向活化空间从高到低的相像区域. 图1(左)显示,在BBQ数据集中,一个在隐藏空间嵌入有偏见和有偏见的提示器上受过训练的逻辑回归分级器作为偏有偏见和有偏见的提示器在模糊的语境中表现不佳,而图1(中)显示,同一分级器以最大概率和最低概率将同一提示器清洁地分开。

blocks.en: Our second contribution is to investigate the impact of steering, equipped with the understanding that using this debiasing vector will shift the model towards low-likelihood responses. We apply activation steering to a suite of LLMs and evaluate the impact on bias benchmarks (BBQ ( Parrish et al., 2022 ) , CrowS-Pairs ( Nangia et al., 2020 ) and StereoSet ( Nadeem et al., 2021 ) ) and general knowledge QA benchmarks (MMLU ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ) , OpenBookQA ( Mihaylov et al., 2018 ) ). Consistent with previous works using steering to debias, we find that activation steering does indeed reduce model bias: the Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct bias score on BBQ ambiguous prompts is reduced from 0.08 to 0.01, indicating very low levels of bias. However, as shown in Fig. 1 (right) this reduction is driven by abstention: when the model is given the option to abstain from responding (e.g “I don’t know”), steering pushes the model towards abstention rather than correcting the underlying stereotype preference. As we will discuss in Sec. 5 , activation steering along this debiasing direction lowers the model’s confidence, resulting in unintended effects on model confidence, accuracy and entropy.
blocks.zh: 我们的第二项贡献是调查方向盘的影响,其理解是,使用这种去偏移的向量将改变模式,使之转向低水平的反应。 我们把激活指导应用于一套LLMS, 并评价对偏差基准的影响(BBQ(Parrish等, 2022年), CrowS-Pairs(Nangia等, 2020年)和StereoSet(Nadeem等, 2021年))和一般知识QA基准(MMLU(Hendrycks等, 2021年), OpenBookQA) (Mihaylov等,2018年). 与之前使用导向去比亚斯的作品一致,我们发现活化引导确实减少了模型偏差:Llama-3.1-8B-指令偏差分从0.08分降至0.01分,表明偏差水平非常低. 然而,如图1(右)所示,这种削减是以弃权为驱动力的:当模式被赋予了放弃回应的选择(例如 " 我不知道 " )时,引导将模式推向弃权,而不是纠正基本的定型观念偏好。 正如我们将在第5节讨论的那样,沿着这个偏离方向启动方向会降低模型的信心,从而对模型的置信性、准确性和 en产生出意料的影响。

blocks.en: Overall, our work shows that steering for LLM debiasing does not correct the underlying stereotyped associations, instead shifting the model’s certainty in its responses in such a way that has unintended consequences on model accuracy and entropy. We argue that reported debiasing via steering should be interpreted with care: what is observed as reduced bias is an artifact of a confounding effect between model confidence and bias rather than evidence of a fairer model.
blocks.zh: 总体来说,我们的工作显示,引导LLM去除偏差并不能纠正潜在的定型联系,而是将模型在反应中的确定性改变为对模型的准确性和 en性产生意想不到的后果。 我们主张,应该谨慎地解释所报道的通过引导去除偏差:人们观察到的减少偏差是在模式信心和偏差之间产生混淆效应的产物,而不是更公平的模式的证据。

blocks.en: The rest of the paper is organised as follows. Sec. 2 reviews related work. Sec. 3 describes the datasets, models and evaluation metrics used. Sec. 4 quantifies the amount of societal bias present in LLMs, describes the construction of a linear classifier used to capture this bias in hidden states, and shows that this bias classifier is in fact capturing model confidence rather than genuine semantic bias. Sec. 5 then explores the implication of this confidence-driven debiasing direction on model behaviour as the model is steered away from it. We discuss our results and conclude in Sec. 6 .

blocks.zh: 2. 相关工作

blocks.en:
Activation steering has been applied to steer models towards or away from a range of behaviours including sycophancy, hallucination, refusal and
truthfulness ( Li et al., 2023a ; Rimsky et al., 2024 ) .
However, a growing body of work questions the robustness of activation steering ( Tan et al., 2024 ; Pres et al., 2024 ) . ( Pres et al., 2024 ) highlights that
steering is frequently assessed based on probabilistic outputs which can obscure the true effect of steering on model behaviour, and advocates for more reliable evaluations based on the underlying distribution of token probabilities. ( Tan et al., 2024 ) analyses the reliability of steering vectors, showing that activation steering is not a universally robust tool for behavioural control.

blocks.en: Our work studies the relationship between LLM bias and LLM confidence as measured by model likelihood. Prior work has used the likelihood as a diagnostic for model bias: when a model assigns higher likelihood to one continuation over an equally valid alternative it reveals a preference, and a systematic preference for the biased continuation can be used as a bias metric ( Parrish et al., 2022 ; Nangia et al., 2020 ; Nadeem et al., 2021 ) . ( Nangia et al., 2020 ) measures bias as the model’s relative log-likelihood on minimally contrastive stereotyped and anti-stereotyped sentence pairs, and ( Barikeri et al., 2021 ) introduces a bias metric based on differences in mean perplexity between statements and their counterfactual variants. These works establish that bias can be detected using the model’s likelihood. Our contribution is to connect this phenomenon to the internal geometry of LLM activation space, showing that the linear direction typically thought to represent model bias in an activation steering context predominantly represents model confidence.

blocks.en: 3. Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3. 实验设置

blocks.en: This section describes the datasets, models and evaluation metrics used throughout the paper with more details being given in Appendix A . Sections 4 and 5 build on this common setup to introduce the linear classifier and steering methodologies respectively.

blocks.en: We use three datasets that are constructed to study societal bias in LLMs: BBQ, StereoSet and CrowS-Pairs ( Parrish et al., 2022 ; Nadeem et al., 2021 ; Nangia et al., 2020 ) . Each BBQ question appears under two context conditions: an ambiguous context, which gives insufficient information to determine the correct answer (so the correct response is to abstain), and a disambiguated context, which adds enough information to determine a definite correct answer. Both StereoSet and CrowS-Pairs only consist of ambiguous contexts. We split each of these three datasets into a 70% training set and a 30% test set. We also use two general knowledge datasets, MMLU and OpenBookQA ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ; Mihaylov et al., 2018 ) , that are designed to probe model performance independently of societal bias. The details of each dataset are given in Appendix A.1 , and the specific prompt formatting in Appendix A.2 .

blocks.en: 4. A linear classifier for bias
blocks.zh: 4.四. 偏差的线性分类器

blocks.en: We start by investigating the concept of bias in LLMs and whether it is present as a linear feature in latent space embeddings. This section is structured as follows. Sec. 4.1 confirms that these models exhibit a significant amount of societal bias, establishing baselines for the remainder of the paper. Sec. 4.2 describes the methodology used to construct a linear classifier that captures bias in the latent space of these models, and investigates the best layer at which this can be done. Sec. 4.3 then shows that the resulting direction captures model confidence rather than semantic bias.
blocks.zh: 我们首先调查LLMS中的偏差概念,以及它是否作为线性特征存在于潜入空间中。 本节的结构如下: 4.1 第4.1款确认,这些模型表现出了相当大的社会偏见,为本文件的其余部分确定了基线。 第4.2节描述了用于构建一种线性分类器的方法,该分类器能够捕捉这些模型潜在空间中的偏差,并调查能够做到这一点的最佳层。 第4.3条随后表明,由此产生的方向捕捉模型自信而不是语义偏差.

blocks.en: 4.2. Methodology: constructing a bias classifier
blocks.zh: 4.2. 方法:构建偏差分类器

blocks.en:
To understand whether bias is linearly encoded in model representations, we train a logistic regression classifier to distinguish biased from anti-biased hidden states. We later show in Sec. 4.3 that this classifier primarily captures confidence rather than bias.
To train the classifier we use only the biased and anti-biased answer options as training examples, excluding any neutral/unrelated third option. This is done for two main reasons. Firstly, the neutral option in BBQ, carries a distinct, and trivially learnable signal as it corresponds to the model abstaining from answering rather than making a biased or anti-biased commitment.
Secondly, restricting to biased and anti-biased options generalises to all three societal bias datasets; BBQ, StereoSet and CrowS-Pairs.
blocks.zh:
为了了解偏差是否在模型表达法中线性地编码,我们训练一个逻辑回归分类器,以区分偏差和反偏差的隐藏状态. 我们后来在第4.3节中显示,这个分类器主要能捕捉到信心而不是偏见.
为了培训分类员,我们只使用有偏见和反偏见的答案选项作为培训实例,不包括任何中立/无关的第三个选项。 这样做有两个主要原因。 首先,在BBQ中,中立的选择带有一个明显和微不足道的可学习的信号,因为它与模式相对应,不回答而不是作出有偏见或有偏见的承诺。
第二,仅限于偏颇和有偏见的选择,将所有三种社会偏见数据集;BBQ、StreoSet和CrowS-Pairs。

blocks.en:
For each dataset, we train exclusively on ambiguous contexts, i.e. the ambiguous context questions from BBQ, and all examples from StereoSet and CrowS-Pairs. This creates a like-for-like comparison across all three datasets as only BBQ has disambiguated contexts.
To construct the prompts, we append the letter corresponding to the biased or anti-biased option and label the prompt correspondingly. We then extract the hidden state at the final token of the full prompt. In this format, this final token is always the answer letter (A, B or C), whose representation is conditioned on the full preceding context (see Figs. 6 - 8 ). We use the training set discussed in Sec. 3 to train the classifier and the test set to assess its performance.

blocks.en: Figure 3. AUROC score of a linear classifier trained on ambiguous biased/anti-biased BBQ prompts as a function of layer number for a selection of models. Base models are shown as the solid lines, while the instruction-tuned version of each model is shown in the same colour but in dashed lines. The circular marker indicates the best layer with the highest AUROC value. AUROC by layer rises sharply from chance to a peak, then declines, but the layer of onset and peak varies by model. Line plot of linear-classifier AUROC as a function of transformer layer (x-axis), for four model families – Falcon3-7B (olive), Llama-3.1-8B (pink), Ministral-3-8B (purple), and Qwen3.5-9B (teal) – each shown as a solid line for the base model and a dashed line for its instruction-tuned counterpart, with a dot marking each curve's peak (best) layer. Every curve starts flat at chance level, marked by a dotted horizontal reference line, through the earliest layers, then rises sharply over a short span of layers before flattening into a peak and declining gradually and somewhat unevenly toward the final layers. The layer at which this rise begins, and the layer at which each curve peaks, differs noticeably across families: for Falcon3-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, and Ministral-3-8B, both the base and instruction-tuned variants rise early and peak within roughly the first third of their layers with the instruction-tuned variant peaking at higher AUROC values and remaining at higher values than the base model towards later layers. Qwen3.5-9B breaks this pattern: its instruction-tuned variant rises and peaks early like the other families, but its base variant instead stays flat at chance well past where every other curve has already peaked, rising only gradually and in an irregular, step-like fashion, and reaching its own peak at the latest layers.

blocks.en: Linear separability of concepts in transformer representations is known to vary across layers, with intermediate layers often capturing some concepts more distinctly as the model processes inputs prior to committing to a final prediction ( Jin et al., 2025 ; Skean et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025 ) . Motivated by this, we do not fix a single layer in advance, but instead choose the classification layer for each model empirically. We do this by training a linear classifier on the hidden states at every layer and evaluating the performance using the AUROC on the held-out test set, using this to determine the best layer per model. Fig. 3 shows this AUROC score as a function of layer depth for all models on the BBQ ambiguous dataset.

blocks.en: In ambiguous contexts, the moderate correlation is surprising: there is no reason why the model should assign a higher probability to the answer classified as most biased by the linear classifier. Disambiguated contexts give a better understanding of what the linear classifier is tracking. Here the context makes the correct answer explicit, removing any ambiguity about which answer a model should prefer. If the classifier was tracking semantic bias, its scores should be uncorrelated with answer probability in this condition as the model’s confidence should now be driven by factual context, not by the stereotypical associations the classifier was trained on. Instead, Table 1 shows that the strengthening of the correlation from ambiguous to disambiguated contexts holds across all models with r S r_{S} rising from a range of 0.01 − 0.45 0.01-0.45 in the ambiguous contexts to 0.57 − 0.80 0.57-0.80 in the disambiguated condition. The effect is strongest for instruction-tuned variants, with consistently higher values of r S r_{S} than their pre-trained counterparts. The fact that the correlation is markedly stronger on the disambiguated BBQ dataset for every model tested indicates that the linear classifier is responding to model confidence rather than bias. When the model is more certain about an answer, it assigns it higher probability and a more extreme bias score, irrespective of whether that answer is biased or anti-biased.

blocks.en:
Neither MMLU nor OpenBookQA contains any concept of societal bias.
If the direction identified by the linear classifier did correspond to a genuine bias signal, the classifier should perform no better than random chance. Instead we find consistently high AUROC scores: Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct achieves 0.88 on OpenBookQA using a classifier trained on BBQ ambiguous prompts or a classifier trained on CrowS-Pairs. The same experiment performed on the disambiguated BBQ subset yields comparably high separability for BBQ-ambiguous-trained classifiers (AUROC 0.79–0.95 across all eight models), though transfer from StereoSet- and CrowS-Pairs-trained classifiers is less consistent. blocks.en: 5. Activation steering along the debiasing direction
blocks.zh: 5 (韩语). 沿着拆卸方向前进

blocks.en: The results of Sec. 4.3 establish that a linear classifier trained to capture bias in latent space embeddings actually captures confidence. In this section we aim to understand the implications of this bias-confidence confound when this direction is used for debiasing strategies that rely on this direction, by applying activation steering and investigating the resulting change in model behaviour. We find that steering away from the debiasing direction does not correct bias in a targeted way. Instead, it reduces model confidence broadly, causing an increase in abstention where an abstain option is available, and an equilibration of the remaining answer probabilities where it is not, as is illustrated in Fig. 5 for the Llama-3.1-8B model family. The same pattern extends even to general-knowledge datasets that contain no notion of societal bias at all. Sec. 5.1 describes the steering setup, and Sec. 5.2 presents the results.
blocks.zh: Sec. 4.3的结果证实,经过培训的线性分类器能够捕捉潜在空间嵌入中的偏差,实际上可以捕捉到信心. 在本节中,我们的目的是通过应用激活引导和调查由此造成的模式行为变化,来理解这一方向被用于削弱依赖这一方向的战略时所困惑的偏见-信心的影响。 我们认为,偏离偏离方向并不能有针对性地纠正偏见。 相反,它从广义上降低了模型的信心,导致在有弃权选择的情况下弃权者增加,在没有弃权选择的情况下,其余答案概率的等同,图5对Llama-3.1-8B模型家族作了说明。 同样的模式甚至扩展到完全没有社会偏见概念的一般知识数据集。 5.1 第5.2节介绍了方向架,5.2 第5.2节介绍了结果。

The star marker shows the natural magnitude of the CAA steering vector. Steering in the debiasing direction raises abstention rates when allowed, and equilibrates answer probabilities when abstaining is not an option. For CrowS-Pairs and StereoSet, whose original format does not involve an abstain option and forces the model to give a definite answer, we add a neutral option while keeping the original options unchanged. blocks.en: To test whether steering has a similarly non-targeted effect outside the domain of societal bias, we additionally apply each of the three debiasing directions, obtained using BBQ-ambiguous, CrowS-Pairs and StereoSet, to the general-knowledge datasets MMLU and OpenBookQA, at that direction’s own best layer, and measure the resulting change in accuracy and answer entropy relative to α = 0 \alpha=0 . blocks.en:
Having confirmed that the debiasing directions and confidence directions show high levels of alignment as measured by cosine similarity,
we now investigate the effects of steering along this debiasing direction.
Fig. 5 shows the impact of activation steering on the pretrained and instruction-tuned variants of the Llama-3.1-8B model, as measured by the probability assigned by the model to each answer token conditioned on the prompt, averaged over all the prompts. When the model is allowed to abstain from answering, as shown in the top two rows of Fig. 5 , the dominant effect of steering in the debiasing direction is an increase in the probability of the abstain answers. This is seen across all datasets in all models, although the change is always largest in the instruction-tuned model. This is likely a consequence of safety training which makes the model more likely to abstain even before any steering is applied. As expected, the probability that the model gives a biased answer drops when steering away from bias. More surprisingly, the anti-biased answer probability also drops in most cases when abstaining is allowed, rising only slightly for CrowS-Pairs and StereoSet in the pre-trained model. This indicates that steering reduces model confidence in both substantive answers, concentrating probability mass on the abstain option and causing the model to abstain from answering more frequently. This is a similar effect to that reported in ( Kumaran et al., 2026 ) , in which steering along a confidence direction is found to directly increase the rates of model abstention, and provides further evidence that the debiasing direction encodes a substantial amount of model confidence.
Because this rising abstention concentrates probability mass onto a single option rather than spreading it across several, entropy does not necessarily increase in this regime. This is in contrast with the no-abstain case discussed next, where a rise in entropy is the expected signature of reduced confidence.
blocks.zh:
确认 偏离方向和信心方向显示高度一致,以余弦相近程度衡量,
我们现在调查沿着这个偏离方向前进的影响。
图5显示了活化向导对Llama-3.1-8B模型被预先训练并被指导调试的变体的影响,以模型给每个答录符设定的概率来衡量,该概率以迅速为条件,在所有提示上均值. 当模型被允许不回答时,如图5前两行所示,向导在去偏移方向上的主要作用是增加弃置答案的概率. 在所有模型中的所有数据集中都可以看到这一点,尽管在指令调制模型中变化总是最大的. 这可能是安全培训的结果,这种培训使模型甚至在应用任何方向之前都更有可能弃权。 如所料,模型在偏离偏差时给出偏差答案的概率会下降. 更出人意料的是,反偏颇的答案概率在允许弃权时在多数情况下也会下降,对于CrowS-Pairs和StreoSet在预训模型中也只是略有上升. 这表明向导降低了模型对两个实质性答案的信心,将概率质量集中在弃权选项上并导致模型更频繁地放弃回答. 这与在(Kumaran等人,2026年)中报告的效果类似,其中发现沿着信任方向走下去会直接提高模型弃权率,并提供了进一步的证据,证明偏离方向编码了大量模型信任.
由于这种不断上升的弃权将概率质量集中在一个单一的选项上,而不是将其分散到几个选项上, en不一定会增加这种制度. 这与接下来讨论的 " 无缺陷 " 案例形成对照,后者的肽含量上升是预期信心下降的标志。

blocks.en:
This behaviour is in contrast to that shown in the lower two rows of Fig. 5 when the model is not allowed to abstain from answering. In this case, steering equilibrates the average probability assigned to each remaining class. This is driven by the model being pushed to a low-confidence regime in latent space.
This equilibration causes entropy to rise, decreasing model confidence and increasing uncertainty.
Entropy over a fixed set of answer options is highest when those options are equally likely, so as steering pushes the probability ratios towards unity, entropy increases with it.
This is similar to the effect of temperature scaling during decoding, where dividing the output logits by a temperature T > 1 T>1 before the softmax function flattens the resulting probability distribution over the available options without changing which option the original logits favoured most.

这种等同性导致 en上升,模型信心下降并增加不确定性.
在固定的一组答案选项上,当这些选项同样可能时,Entropy是最高的,这样一来,当向统一方向推进概率比时,Entropy随它而增加.
这与解码过程中温度缩放的效果类似,在软马克函数平平平现有选项的概率分布之前,将输出对数除以温度 T > 1 T>1,而不改变原对数最偏爱的选项。

blocks.en: Next, we analyse the impact of steering on model accuracy, bias and entropy as shown for all models and datasets in Table 4 . The behaviour shown in Figure 5 can easily be misinterpreted as a correct approach to debiasing; for the BBQ ambiguous prompts, the increase in abstention leads to a higher accuracy and lower bias score as can indeed be seen in Table 4 . The reduction in the bias score, however, is a direct consequence of how the ambiguous bias score is defined in Equation ( 2 ) with a ( 1 − accuracy ) (1-\mathrm{accuracy}) scaling, even though the underlying preference between the biased and anti-biased answers remains largely unchanged. The disambiguous bias score s dis s_{\mathrm{dis}} , which does not depend on the abstention rate, stays roughly flat under steering across all models, showing that steering has little to no effect on bias in this context. Table 4 also shows a systematic reduction in accuracy on the disambiguous BBQ dataset across all models, which is a direct consequence of the increased rate of abstention, even though there is enough information for the model to make a substantiated choice. This is a very strong signal indicating that the model is not becoming less biased in its choice between the biased and anti-biased answers; it is becoming less confident overall.

blocks.zh: CrowS-Pairs和StreoSet也一样。 这些数据集没有弃权的选择,因此,在指导(表4)下,偏见回答百分比的下降不能归因于弃权增加。 相反,在减少偏差的同时,还出现了与上述等同效应相符合的等同性增高,而不是真正倾向于反偏颇的答案.

blocks.en:
Finally, in order to test the impact of steering with the debiasing direction on general model behaviour, we assess the change in accuracy and entropy in the MMLU and OpenBookQA general-knowledge datasets.
The results are shown in Table 5 . Across all eight models, steering with any of the three directions leaves accuracy either intact or reduces it, while substantially increasing answer entropy. Steering Qwen3.5-9B with the StereoSet direction at its natural magnitude, for instance, more than doubles OpenBookQA entropy (0.24 to 0.50) and raises MMLU entropy by 80% (0.34 to 0.61). The largest accuracy cost we observe anywhere in Table 5 is in the Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model, which shows a reduction in accuracy from 0.76 to 0.70 in OpenBookQA under BBQ steering. Overall, accuracy is mostly unaffected because steering pushes the answer probabilities toward a common midpoint without reordering them, leaving the ranking of the candidate answers unchanged. The greedy-decoded answer is usually unaffected as the distribution flattens and entropy rises.
blocks.zh:
最后,为了测试用去偏振方向来引导对一般模型行为的影响,我们评估了MMLU和OpenBookQA一般知识数据集的精度和py的变化.
结果见表5。 在所有8个模型中,用三个方向中的任何方向来向导,要么保持准确性,要么降低准确性,同时大幅度地增加答案 en. 以立体Set指向其自然规模为取向的Quen3.5-9B,例如双倍多的OpenBookQA en(0.24至0.50),将MMLU en提高80%(0.34至0.61). 在表5中,我们观察到的最大精度成本是Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct模型,该模型显示在BBQ引导下OpenBookQA的精度从0.76降至0.70. 总体而言,准确性大都未受影响,因为方向将答案概率推向一个共同的中点,而不重新排列,使候选人答案的排名保持不变。 贪取解码的答案通常不会随着分布平地和 en的上升而受到影响.

blocks.en: Since neither MMLU nor OpenBookQA contains any specific societal-bias notions, there is no semantic bias for the debiasing direction to correct. Regardless, steering raises answer entropy while slightly lowering task accuracy, mirroring the effect of temperature scaling rather than providing a targeted correction. This highlights the risks associated with debiasing by activation steering. Although Table 4 shows a reduction in overall bias metrics, this is consistently accompanied by an unavoidable increase in model abstention or model entropy depending on the QA dataset format, a result of the debiasing direction encoding model confidence.
blocks.zh: 既不是MMLU,也不是OpenBook QA包含任何特定的社会偏见概念,对于去除偏见的方向没有语义上的偏差来纠正. 无论如何,向导会提高答录率,同时略微降低任务精度,反映温度缩放的效果,而不是提供有针对性的校正. 这凸显出通过活化向导去除扰动的风险. 虽然表4显示总体偏差度量的下降,但始终伴随着模型弃权或模型 en因QA数据集格式而不可避免地增加,这是偏离方向编码模型信心的结果.

blocks.en: 6. Discussion and conclusions
blocks.zh: 6. 讨论和结论

blocks.en: Our work uses an intepretability lens to understand how LLMs behave when activation steering is used to debias their outputs. As discussed in Sec. 1 , LLMs carry biases inherent to their training data, and inference-time debiasing methods are particularly popular because they are simple to apply and computationally cheaper than alternatives such as fine-tuning. However, this convenience is only valuable if the resulting behaviour can be understood and trusted: without reliability, these methods risk going unused, leaving models biased.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作使用不透视镜来理解LLMs在使用活化向导去除其输出时的表现. 如第1节所讨论,法学硕士课程带有其培训数据固有的偏见,推论时间解析方法尤其受欢迎,因为这些方法比微调等替代方法简单易用,计算成本更低。 然而,只有当由此产生的行为能够被理解和信任时,这种方便才有价值:没有可靠性,这些方法就有被使用的危险,留下了模型的偏差.

blocks.en: Our analysis finds that the debiasing direction, pointing from biased to anti-biased prompts in LLM activation space, is dominated by model confidence rather than demographic bias. We show that a logistic regression classifier trained to separate biased and anti-biased prompts achieves an AUROC as high as 0.9 when tested on low versus high-probability prompts from the general knowledge MMLU dataset, despite this dataset encoding no concept of demographic bias. Cosine similarities in the range 0.3-0.9 are found between the debiasing vector and confidence vectors extracted from MMLU and OpenBookQA. The debiasing direction is not just entangled with the confidence direction in activation space: a difference in likelihoods is an inherent feature of biased and anti-biased prompts, arising as a consequence of the over-representation of biased sentences in LLM pretraining data ( Gallegos et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们的分析发现,从LLM活化空间的偏好到反偏见的诱因的偏离方向,是以模型自信而不是人口偏见为主. 我们显示,经过培训的后勤回归分类器可以区分偏见和反偏见的诱因,在从一般知识MMLU数据集对低概率和高概率的诱因进行测试时,AUROC达到0.9,尽管该数据集编码中没有人口偏差的概念。 从MMLU和OpenBookQA中提取的去偏振向量和置信向量在0.3-0.9范围内的同位素相似. 偏离方向不仅与激活空间中的信心方向相缠:可能性的差异是偏颇和反偏颇的提示的内在特征,由LLM预训数据中偏颇的句子过多而出(Gallegos等,2024年).

blocks.en:
This has implications for activation steering: steering along the confidence-dominated debiasing direction impacts the model’s confidence in its responses rather than directly reducing model bias.
In cases where the model has the option to abstain from responding (e.g. "I don’t know"), the rate of abstention increases with steering while the rates of both biased and anti-biased responses decreases indiscriminately. This builds on the results of ( Kumaran et al., 2026 ) which shows that steering in a low-confidence direction directly increases the rate of model abstention in multiple choice QA benchmarks.
blocks.zh:
这对激活方向有影响:沿着以信心为主的偏离方向前进会影响模型对其反应的信心,而不是直接减少模型偏差。
在模型可以选择不回应(如"我不知道")的情况下,弃权率随方向而上升,而偏见和反偏见反应率则不加区别地下降. 这基于(Kumaran等人,2026年)的结果,该结果表明,在多种选择的质量保证基准中,以低信心方向进行引导直接提高模型弃权率。

blocks.en: When the model has no option to abstain, we observe the rates of anti-biased responses increase and the rates of biased responses decrease. Steering redistributes the model’s probability in each response option, moving from a regime in which most of the probability mass is placed on a single option (the biased response) to a regime where all options have a similar probability. This leads to small reductions in model accuracy, and a large increase in entropy on both bias and general knowledge benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 当模型无法选择弃权时,我们看到反偏见反应率上升,有偏见反应率下降. 引导在每一个响应选项中重新分配模型的概率,从将大部分概率质量置于单一选项(有偏见的响应)的制度转向所有选项概率相近的制度。 这导致模型精度小幅下降,并导致在偏差和一般知识基准上等同物素大量增加.

blocks.en: Overall, our work demonstrates that when steering does debias QA benchmarks successfully, it does so for the wrong reasons. Steering towards low confidence pushes the model to abstain from answering where possible, and otherwise redistributes model probability among the available multiple choice options regardless of their factual correctness, reducing model accuracy on downstream tasks. A reduction in bias achieved through steering-based debiasing should therefore be interpreted with care and may reflect shifts in model confidence rather than a genuine improvement in model fairness.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,我们的工作表明,当指导成功实现 " 质量评估 " 基准时,它是出于错误的理由。 向低信心的方向走去,促使模型尽可能不回答,否则就将模型概率重新分配到现有的多种选择选项中,不管其真实正确性如何,降低模型对下游任务的准确性. 因此,应当谨慎地解释通过定向脱轨减少偏见的做法,并可能反映模式信心的变化,而不是模式公平性的真正改善。

blocks.en: Future work will study whether a debiasing direction which is independent of model confidence can be found, and whether this confound impacts inference-time debiasing techniques beyond activation steering. More broadly, it will be important to investigate the prevalence of this effect on other steering vectors based on the linear representation hypothesis, particularly those used in an AI safety context.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作将研究是否能够找到一个独立于模型置信度的去偏移取向,以及这是否使推论时间去偏移技术超出活化取向。 更广泛地说,有必要根据线性表示假设,特别是AI安全背景中使用的假设,调查这种影响对其他方向向量的普遍程度。

blocks.en: A.1. Datasets
blocks.zh: A.1. 数据集

blocks.en: BBQ. The BBQ dataset is a multiple-choice question set designed to probe societal bias in LLMs across nine demographic characteristics. These are age, disability status, gender identity, nationality, physical appearance, race/ethnicity, religion, socio-economic status and sexual orientation. It also includes two intersectional biases; gender by race/ethnicity and socio-economic status by race/ethnicity ( Parrish et al., 2022 ) . Each question offers three answer options: a stereotypically biased answer, an anti-biased answer, and a neutral option in which the model declines to answer (e.g. ‘Can’t be determined’ or ‘Unknown’).
blocks.zh: BBQ (英语). BBQ数据集是一个多选题集,旨在从9个人口特征中探寻LLMs中的社会偏差. 这些是年龄、残疾状况、性别认同、国籍、外貌、种族/族裔、宗教、社会经济地位和性取向。 它还包括两种交叉偏见:按种族/族裔划分的性别以及按种族/族裔划分的社会经济状况(Parrish等,2022年)。 每个问题提供了三种答案选择:陈规定型偏颇的答案、反偏见的答案、以及模式拒绝回答的中性选择(如`无法确定 ' 或`未知 ' )。

blocks.en: Questions appear in one of two context conditions. In disambiguated contexts sufficient information is given for a definitive answer; the biased option is correct for half of these questions, the anti-biased option is correct for the other half, while the neutral option is never correct. In ambiguous contexts, the question can never be answered from the context given. In this case, the neutral option is the only correct answer, and any preference given by the model to the biased answer reflects societal bias acquired during training. Our experiments use a total of 15960 prompts from the BBQ dataset.
blocks.zh: 问题出现在两个背景条件中的一个。 在模糊不清的情况下,为确定答案提供足够的信息;其中一半问题的偏颇选择是正确的,而另一半问题的偏颇选择是正确的,而中立选择则永远不对。 在模棱两可的情况下,这个问题永远无法从上下文中解答。 在这种情况下,中立的选择是唯一正确的答案,模型对有偏见的答案的任何偏好都反映了在培训期间获得的社会偏见. 我们的实验总共使用了15960个来自BBQ数据集的提示.

blocks.en: StereoSet. StereoSet is a question-answering dataset that is designed to test stereotypical bias ( Nadeem et al., 2021 ) . Similarly to BBQ, each question presents three answer options: a stereotypically biased completion, an anti-biased completion, and a semantically unrelated completion. The dataset contains two tasks: intersentence and intrasentence. In the intersentence task, the model is given a context sentence and must select the most appropriate follow-up sentence from the three options. In the intrasentence task, the model is given a sentence with a single missing word and must select the correct completion. We use only the intrasentence subset in this work since this task is more closely aligned with the BBQ format, in which answer options are at most a short phrase rather than a full sentence. As well as this, the single-word structure of the intrasentence answer options provides a cleaner signal for isolating a linear bias direction in activation space. This intrasentence dataset consists of a total of 2106 unique questions.
blocks.zh: 立体声 Set是一个问答数据集,旨在测试定型偏见(Nadeem等,2021年). 与BBQ类似,每个问题都提出了三个答案选项:陈规定型的有偏见的完成,反偏见的完成,和与事实无关的完成. 数据集包含两项任务:判决期间和判决期间。 在判决期间的任务中,该模型被赋予上下文句,必须从三个选项中选择最合适的后续句. 在判决内的任务中,给模型一个句子,只缺一个单词,必须选择正确的完成. 我们只在这项工作中使用判决内部的子集,因为这项任务与BBQ格式更加一致,其中答案选项最多是一个简短的短语,而不是一个完整的句子。 除此之外,判决内回答选项的单词结构为隔离激活空间中的线性偏差方向提供了更清洁的信号. 这个判决内数据集包含总共2106个独特的问题.

blocks.en:
CrowS-Pairs. The CrowS-Pairs dataset ( Nangia et al., 2020 ) consists of 1508 sentence pairs in which one sentence exhibits a social stereotype, while the other is a minimally different sentence that goes against this stereotype.
This dataset was designed to measure the bias present in a pre-trained model by calculating perplexity: a biased model will have a higher perplexity value for the sentence that goes against stereotypes compared to its stereotypical sentence pair.
blocks.zh:
(原始内容存档于2013-10-12). CrowS-Pairs. CrowS-Pairs数据集(Nangia等,2020年)由1508个句子组成,其中一句展现出一种社会定型,而另一句则是与这种定型相反的最小不同句子.
这套数据集的目的是通过计算偏差来测量预先训练的模型中存在的偏差:偏差模型相对于其定型的一对句子而言,对句子的偏差值会更高.

blocks.en: To ensure minimal variation between paired sentences and avoid confounds such as simultaneous negation changes, we retain only pairs differing by exactly one word, yielding 1,018 examples. To match the format of the other datasets used in this work, we convert CrowS-Pairs to a question-answering format. For each pair, we replace the differing word with a blank and present the biased and anti-biased completions as the two answer options, asking the model “Which word or phrase best completes the sentence?”. We give examples of the prompts and their formatting in Sec. A.2 .
blocks.zh: 为了确保对等句之间的最小差异并避免同时否定变化等混乱,我们只保留一个字的不同对子,得出了1 018个例子。 为了与本作中使用的其他数据集格式相匹配,我们将 CrowS-Pairs 转换为问答格式. 对于每一对,我们用空白来取而代之,并将有偏见和有偏见的完成作为两个答案选项,要求模型“哪个词或短语最能完成句子?” 我们以Sec.A.2的形式举例说明这些提示。

blocks.en: As discussed in Sec. 3 , each of the three datasets (BBQ, StereoSet and CrowS-Pairs), is split into a 70% training set and a 30% test set. For BBQ, an ambiguous prompt and its corresponding disambiguated prompt are kept within the same split, so that a classifier or steering direction fit on a prompt’s ambiguous form is never evaluated on that same prompt’s disambiguated form. Both splits also preserve a 50-50 balance between disambiguated items for which the biased answer is correct, and those for which the anti-biased answer is correct, so that behavioural metrics computed on either split are not confounded by an accuracy-bias trade-off. The training set is used to train the linear classifier (Sec. 4 ), and to find the steering direction (Sec. 5 ), in both cases restricted to ambiguous-context prompts. The test set is then used to assess the performance of the linear classifier, for both in-distribution (ambiguous) and out-of-distribution (disambiguated) examples, and to evaluate the impact of steering on model behaviour.
blocks.zh: 如第3节所讨论,三个数据集(BBQ, StereoSet和CrowS-Pairs)各被分为70%的训练集和30%的测试集. 对于BBQ来说,一个模棱两可的提示和相应的模棱两可的提示被保留在同一分法之内,这样就永远不能用同一提示的模棱两可的形式来评价一个符合模棱两可形式的分类器或方向。 两种分法还保持了偏差答案正确、偏差答案正确、相互矛盾项目的50-50个平衡,因此在两种分法上计算的行为衡量标准不会被精确-比斯权衡所混淆。 培训集用于培训线性分类器(sec. 4)并找到方向(sec. 5),在这两种情况下都仅限于模糊的文字提示. 然后,测试集用于评估线性分类器的性能,既用于分配(矛盾),也用于分配(分裂)之外的例子,并用于评估指导对模式行为的影响.

blocks.en: MMLU. The Massive Multitask Language Understanding (MMLU) benchmark is a multiple-choice evaluation dataset spanning 57 tasks including subjects such as STEM, humanities and social sciences. Each question presents four answer options (A–D) and is designed to probe world knowledge and problem-solving capabilities rather than societal bias. We use a subset of 10,000 prompts drawn from across all categories to investigate how the debiasing direction learned from the previous three datasets relates to general model behaviour and the impact that activation steering with this debiasing direction has on model performance.
blocks.zh: 门卢。 大规模多任务语言理解(MMLU)基准是一个多选择评价数据集,涵盖57个任务,包括STEM,人文和社会科学等学科. 每个问题都提出了四个答案选项(A-D),旨在探究世界知识和解决问题的能力,而不是社会偏见。 我们利用从所有类别抽取的一万个提示子来调查从前三个数据集中吸取的去偏移方向如何与一般模式行为相关联,以及这种去偏移方向的激活方向对模式性能的影响。

blocks.en: OpenBookQA. We also make use of OpenBookQA ( Mihaylov et al., 2018 ) as another benchmark dataset that is not related to societal bias. This is a multiple-choice question answering dataset modelled on open-book examinations. It consists of around 6,000 four-choice questions based on a set of 1,329 science facts. Each question requires the LLM to combine one of these core scientific facts with general knowledge, making it a test of reasoning capability instead of just a retrieval test. We use the full dataset as a test set.
blocks.zh: OpenBookQA (英语). 我们还利用OpenBookQA(Mihaylov等,2018年)作为与社会偏见无关的另一个基准数据集. 这是仿照开放式图书考试的多选题答题数据集. 它由大约6000个以1,329个科学事实为基础的四选题组成. 每个问题都要求LLM将这些核心科学事实之一与一般知识相结合,使其成为推理能力的测试,而不只是检索测试. 我们使用完整的数据集作为测试集.

blocks.en: In Section 4.3 , a linear classifier, trained on the binary task of identifying biased vs anti-biased prompts, is evaluated as a classifier of model confidence on on the BBQ (disambig.), MMLU and OpenBookQA datasets. Since the questions in these datasets offer three to four answer options rather than the two (biased/anti-biased) pairs that the bias linear classifier was trained on, we form this confidence-based test set by keeping, for each question, only the two most extreme answers under the model, the highest and lowest probability options, to mirror the two-way comparison used during training.
blocks.zh: 在4.3节中,一个线性分类器接受了识别偏差与反偏见提示的二进制任务的培训,被评价为BBQ(diambig.),MMLU和OpenBookQA数据集上模型信任的分类器. 由于这些数据集中的问题提供了3到4个答案选项,而不是偏差线性分类器所训练的2个(偏差/偏差)对子,所以我们形成这种基于信心的测试集,每个问题只保留模型下最极端的两个答案,即最高和最低概率选项,以映射培训时采用的双向比较.

The same core prompt consisting of the context (where applicable), question, and answer options is used for: (1) answer generation, used to measure bias score and accuracy before and after steering, and (2) extracting the last-token hidden state for each candidate answer, used to train the linear classifier and to compute the CAA direction.

blocks.en: For 2 , the model does not complete the prompt itself. blocks.en: A.3. Evaluation Metric Details
blocks.zh: A.3. 评价计量细节

blocks.en: Here we give details of the evaluation metrics used as introduced in Sec. 3 .
blocks.zh: 在此,我们详细介绍第3节中采用的评价指标。

blocks.en: We assess linear classifier performance using the Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve (AUROC), which measures the probability that a randomly drawn positive example receives a higher classifier score than a randomly drawn negative example. An AUROC of 0.5 indicates no discriminative ability (equivalent to random chance), while a value of 1.0 indicates perfect separation.
blocks.zh: 我们使用“接收者操作特征曲线下的区域”来评估线性分类器的性能,该曲线测量随机抽取的正例获得比随机抽取的负例更高的分数的概率。 0.5的AUROC表示没有歧视能力(相当于随机机会),而1.0的值表示完美的分离.

blocks.en: To assess the amount of bias present in models when using the BBQ dataset, we use the bias score s AMB s_{\mathrm{AMB}} and s DIS s_{\mathrm{DIS}} for ambiguous and disambiguous contexts respectively, defined in ( Parrish et al., 2022 ) and shown in Equations ( 1 ) and ( 2 ).
blocks.zh: 为了评估模型在使用 BBQ 数据集时存在的偏差程度,我们使用偏差分数 s AMB s- mathrm{ AMB}} 和 s DIS s- mathrm{ DIS}} 分别用于定义模糊和矛盾的背景(Parrish等人,2022年),并用方程式 (1)和 (2)来显示.

blocks.en: We quote bias scores on the StereoSet and CrowS-Pairs datasets as the percentage of biased answers given by the model.
blocks.zh: 我们引用了 StereoSet 和 CrowS-Pairs 数据集的偏差分数作为模型给出的偏差答案的百分比.

blocks.en: Accuracy is the fraction of prompts for which the model assigns its highest probability to the objectively correct answer, and is only defined for datasets with a ground-truth correct answer (BBQ disambiguous, MMLU and OpenBookQA); CrowS-Pairs and StereoSet have no correct answer and are excluded from this metric.
blocks.zh: 准确性是模型将最高概率分配给客观正确答案的提示的分数,它只被定义为具有地上真实正确答案的数据集(BBQ分化,MMLU和OpenBookQA); CrowS-Pairs和Streeo Set没有正确的答案,因此被排除在这一衡量标准之外。

blocks.en: Entropy measures how concentrated the model’s probability mass is across the available answer options and is often used as a measure of LLM uncertainty ( Kuhn et al., 2023 ) . High entropy means the model is unsure among the answer choices, while low entropy means the model is confident about its answer choice. Entropy is defined as (5) H = − ∑ a ∈ A P ( a ∣ prompt ) log P ( a ∣ prompt ) , H=-\sum_{a\in A}P(a\mid\text{prompt})\log P(a\mid\text{prompt})\,, where A A is the set of candidate answers.

blocks.en: Table 6 extends the per-layer AUROC analysis of Sec. 4 (Fig. 3 ) to StereoSet and CrowS-Pairs, reporting the best-performing layer and its AUROC for every model on all three bias datasets. Two patterns stand out beyond what Sec. 4.2 already covers for BBQ. First, StereoSet and CrowS-Pairs are consistently easier to linearly separate than BBQ (ambig.): every model’s best AUROC is higher on both datasets than on BBQ, typically by 0.15–0.25 (e.g. Ministral-3-8B-Base: 0.73 on BBQ vs. 0.95 on StereoSet), with the exception of Qwen3.5-9B-Base, where the gap is much smaller (0.68 vs. 0.76 on StereoSet, 0.68 vs. 0.82 on CrowS-Pairs). This is due to the fact that CrowS-Pairs and StereoSet datasets contain, on average, shorter prompts than BBQ, in which the longer sentences obscure the bias signal. Second, while the best layer is broadly consistent across datasets within a model, and between the base and instruction-tuned variant of a given model family (differing by at most two or three layers for Llama-3.1-8B, Falcon3-7B, and Ministral-3-8B), Qwen3.5-9B is the clear exception: its base variant reaches peak AUROC only at layer 26–30, ten to thirteen layers later than its own instruction-tuned counterpart (layer 16–17), and with a substantially lower AUROC (0.68/0.76/0.82 vs. 0.74/0.94/0.94). This mirrors the base-model outlier already visible in Fig. 3 for BBQ, and shows the same pattern holds for StereoSet and CrowS-Pairs: for every model except Qwen3.5-9B-Base, a linear bias direction emerges at a broadly similar depth and separates the two classes with a comparably high AUROC across all three bias-evaluation datasets.

blocks.en: The main observed trend is that when abstention is allowed, the ratio of neutral (abstain) to anti-biased answers always increases with increasing α \alpha as models tend to abstain more frequently, as shown by Table 8 .
blocks.zh: 观察到的主要趋势是,如果允许弃权,中立(弃权)与反偏见的答案的比例总是随着α-α的增加而增加,因为模型往往更经常地弃权,如表8所示。

blocks.en:
At the same time, the ratio of biased to anti-biased probabilities either decreases or remains roughly constant, as shown in Table 9 .
This ratio remains constant in cases where the model reports low baseline bias scores and, as a result, the biased and anti-biased probabilities are very close to begin with at α = 0 \alpha=0 : this includes all models when evaluated on BBQ (dis.), and all models except for the Llama family when evaluated on BBQ (ambig.) - see Table 4 for baseline bias scores. The reduction of the ratio of biased to anti-biased probabilities shows that the model is steered towards a region of hidden space in which biased and anti-biased responses are treated equally. However, combined with the increase in abstention probability shown in Table 8 , this does not signify a debiased model: instead, the model indiscriminately places the probability mass in the abstention option, even when the prompt contains enough context for the model to make a definite answer as in BBQ (dis.).

blocks.en: When there is no abstain option, as shown in Table 10 , the ratio of biased to anti-biased mean probability tends towards one, as both answer types become equally likely under steering, a consequence of the model becoming less uncertain about its answer choice.
